s: Happy is the one who delights in God's law: like a tree planted by streams of water.
The nations rage against the Lord and his anointed, but God says: You are my Son.
A morning prayer in danger: the Lord is my shield.
An evening prayer: in peace I will lie down and sleep.
A morning prayer for guidance against enemies.
A prayer for healing and mercy in distress.
A prayer for God's justice against false accusers.
How majestic is your name in all the earth. What is man, that you are mindful of him?
Thanks to God for defeating enemies; he is a refuge for the oppressed.
Why does God seem far off when the wicked oppress the poor? Arise, Lord.
In the Lord I take refuge; he sees all from his holy temple.
The faithful have vanished, but God's words are pure.
How long, O Lord, will you forget me? Yet I trust in your mercy.
The fool says in his heart: there is no God.
Who may dwell on God's holy mountain? The one who walks blamelessly.
You are my portion and cup; you will not leave my soul among the dead.
A prayer of an innocent person seeking God's protection.
David's song of thanks for deliverance: the Lord is my rock and fortress.
The heavens declare the glory of God, and his law gives light to the eyes.
A prayer for the king before battle.
Thanksgiving for the king's victory.
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? A cry of suffering that ends in praise, prayed by Jesus on the cross.
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
The earth is the Lord's. Lift up your heads, O gates, that the King of glory may come in.
To you, O Lord, I lift up my soul. Teach me your paths.
A plea of a person of integrity to be vindicated.
The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
A prayer for help, and thanks that it was heard.
The voice of the Lord thunders over the waters.
Thanks for healing: weeping may last for a night, but joy comes in the morning.
Into your hands I commend my spirit.
Happy is the one whose sin is forgiven.
Sing a new song to the Lord, who made the heavens by his word.
Taste and see that the Lord is good.
A prayer for rescue from unjust enemies.
The wickedness of sinners and the steadfast love of God.
Do not fret because of evildoers; trust in the Lord and do good.
A sick and sinful man's prayer of repentance.
Life is a breath; my hope is in you, Lord.
I waited patiently for the Lord, and he heard my cry. Here I am, I come to do your will.
Happy is the one who cares for the poor. Even my friend has turned against me.
As the deer longs for running streams, so my soul longs for you, O God.
Send out your light and truth; why are you cast down, my soul?
Israel recalls God's past help and asks why he has now rejected them.
A royal wedding song in praise of the king and his bride.
God is our refuge and strength. Be still and know that I am God.
God is king over all the earth; clap your hands.
Zion, the city of God, is beautiful and secure.
Wealth cannot save anyone from death, but God will ransom my soul.
God does not want sacrifices without obedience; offer him thanks.
Have mercy on me, O God. Create a clean heart in me. David's prayer of repentance.
The boastful wicked will fall, but I am like an olive tree in God's house.
The fool says there is no God.
Save me, O God, by your name.
Betrayed by a friend, the psalmist casts his burden on the Lord.
When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.
My heart is steadfast; I will awaken the dawn.
God will judge unjust rulers.
A prayer for deliverance from bloodthirsty enemies.
A prayer after defeat: with God we shall do valiantly.
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
My soul rests in God alone.
O God, my soul thirsts for you like a dry land without water.
A prayer for protection from secret plots.
Praise for God who answers prayer and blesses the land with rain and harvest.
All the earth worships God for his mighty deeds.
May God be gracious to us and bless us, that all nations may praise him.
God marches in triumph and is a father to the fatherless.
Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck. Zeal for your house has consumed me.
Make haste to help me, O Lord.
An old man's prayer: you have been my hope since my youth.
A prayer for the king: may he defend the poor, and may all nations serve him.
Why do the wicked prosper? Then I went into God's sanctuary and understood their end.
A lament over the destruction of the sanctuary.
God judges the earth with justice.
God is known in Judah and breaks the power of the enemy.
In distress I remember the deeds of the Lord.
The story of God's wonders for Israel and their unbelief, to be told to the next generation.
The nations have defiled Jerusalem; help us, God of our salvation.
Restore us, O God, and let your face shine. The vine you brought out of Egypt.
A festival call to worship and to listen to God.
God judges the rulers, who are called gods.
A prayer against the nations conspiring against Israel.
How lovely is your dwelling place, O Lord of hosts.
Mercy and truth have met; justice and peace have kissed.
A prayer of a poor man in trouble: teach me your way, O Lord.
Zion is the mother of all nations.
The darkest of the psalms: a cry from one near death.
God's covenant with David, and a lament that it seems broken.
Lord, you have been our refuge in every generation. Teach us to number our days.
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High: God will give his angels charge over you.
It is good to give thanks to the Lord.
The Lord is king, robed in majesty.
God will judge the proud and comfort the faithful.
Come, let us sing to the Lord. Today, if you hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
Sing to the Lord a new song; he comes to judge the earth.
The Lord reigns; let the earth rejoice.
Sing a new song, for the Lord has done marvellous things.
The Lord is king and holy; worship at his footstool.
Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth.
The king promises to walk with integrity.
A prayer of an afflicted person: you, Lord, remain for ever.
Bless the Lord, my soul. He forgives all your sins and is rich in mercy.
God's wisdom in creation. Send forth your Spirit and renew the face of the earth.
The story of God's faithfulness to Abraham and his people.
The story of Israel's sins and God's mercy.
Give thanks to the Lord, who rescues those in distress.
My heart is steadfast, O God.
A prayer against false accusers.
The Lord says to my lord: sit at my right hand. You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
Great are the works of the Lord.
Happy is the one who fears the Lord.
Praise the Lord, who raises the poor from the dust.
When Israel came out of Egypt, the sea fled.
Not to us, O Lord, but to your name give glory. Idols have mouths but cannot speak.
What shall I return to the Lord? I will take the cup of salvation.
Praise the Lord, all you nations.
The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is the day the Lord has made.
The longest psalm, in praise of God's law: your word is a lamp to my feet.
In my distress I cried to the Lord.
I lift up my eyes to the hills: my help comes from the Lord.
I rejoiced when they said to me: let us go to the house of the Lord.
As the eyes of servants look to their master, our eyes look to the Lord.
If the Lord had not been on our side, we would have been swallowed up.
Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion.
Those who sow in tears will reap with songs of joy.
Unless the Lord builds the house, they labour in vain who build it.
Blessed are all who fear the Lord; your children like olive shoots.
Often they have attacked me, but they have not prevailed.
Out of the depths I cry to you, O Lord.
My heart is not proud; I am like a child quieted at its mother's breast.
God's promise to David and his choice of Zion.
How good and pleasant it is when brothers live in unity.
Bless the Lord, all you servants of the Lord, in the night.
Praise the Lord, who is greater than all gods.
Give thanks to the Lord, for his mercy endures for ever.
By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept, remembering Zion.
I thank you with all my heart; the Lord cares for the lowly.
O Lord, you have searched me and you know me. You knit me together in my mother's womb.
Deliver me, Lord, from evil men.
Let my prayer rise like incense before you.
I cry out to the Lord from the cave.
Do not enter into judgment with your servant. Teach me to do your will.
Blessed be the Lord my rock, who trains my hands for war.
I will praise your name for ever. The Lord is gracious and merciful.
Put no trust in princes; the Lord gives justice to the oppressed.
The Lord heals the broken-hearted and counts the stars.
Praise the Lord from the heavens and from the earth.
Sing to the Lord a new song; he delights in his people.
Let everything that has breath praise the Lord.

22: My God, why have you forsaken me

Jesus prays the first words of this psalm on the cross ([[Matthew 27:46|matthew/27/46]], [[Mark 15:34|mark/15/34]]). The Gospels see the rest of it fulfilled at Calvary too: the mocking crowd ([[Matthew 27:39-43|matthew/27/39]]) and the soldiers casting lots for his garments ([[John 19:24|john/19/24]]). The psalm begins in anguish but ends in praise and hope.
23: The best-loved psalm: God cares for us like a shepherd, even in the valley of death.
51: Written after David's sin with Bathsheba, this psalm asks God for a clean heart. The Church prays it often, especially in Lent.

Here: the inner self, what lies within a person.
25: The bowels were thought of as the seat of feeling. Here: the heart, deep compassion.
